python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

overrides = {}
for line in Path('/config/overrides.txt').read_text().splitlines():
    if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
        continue
    key, value = line.split('=', 1)
    overrides[key.strip()] = value

result = []
for line in Path('/config/template.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
        continue
    match = re.fullmatch(r'\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=\$\{[^}:]+:-(.*)\}\s*', line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f'Unsupported template line: {line!r}')
    key, default = match.groups()
    result.append(f'{key}={overrides[key] if key in overrides else default}')

output = '\n'.join(result) + '\n'
Path('/app').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
Path('/app/.env').write_text(output)
print(output, end='')
PY
